quality.stories: Stories follow the 'Eu como doador/voluntário' form, one per flow (schedule, reschedule, confirm, receipt); the conflicting rules are kept out of stories.
quality.criteria: Criteria are confirmed for the uncontested rules (scheduling, receipt, email, no receipt before confirmation) and the conflicts are not turned into criteria, which is the intended behavior.
quality.tasks: Tasks are concrete and tied to the criteria; T2 names the open interpretation Q3, which keeps the open point visible in the work plan.
quality.traceability: Each conflict claim carries both PRD and manual quotes, and the epic lists the conflicts as out of scope with the question references.

notes: The gold expectation (conflicts for limit and electronics) is well met. The gold does not capture the calendar-vs-24h reading of the reschedule window, which is the source of the medium invention on AC3.
